findings.title: PlatformOcrProvider (VisionPipeline) is wired to the screenshot bridge but severed from MediaProcessor's image-attachment fallback
findings.rationale: Producer and consumer both exist and are fully implemented, only the startup wire is missing. Producer: PlatformOcrProvider::with_platform (this file, fully tested; its OCR routes through the platform screen/Swift bridge) plus VisionPipeline. Consumer: MediaProcessor::describe_image_fallback (src/media/processor.rs:226) which, when self.vision is Some, runs pipeline.understand_image over attached images and emits '[Image: <description>]'. The wire is severed at server startup: agent_init/mod.rs:1187 hardcodes 'let vision: Option<Arc<VisionPipeline>> = None;' with the comment 'VisionPipeline is not currently created at startup — pass None for now'. Read-first confirmed a LIVE caller: run_loop/inner.rs:548 calls media_processor.process(attachments, supports_vision=false, ...) for text-only models, which reaches describe_image_fallback and, because vision is None, degrades to '[Image: name — not viewable by this model]' — silently discarding the image content. The same producer is already constructed and registered for the desktop screenshot bridge at constructor/mod.rs:337, proving the provider works in production. No error path or newer mechanism covers 'describe attached image for a text-only model', so this is a genuine dark feature, not a painless severed wire. Reconnection is a small, low-coupling change: build a VisionPipeline with PlatformOcrProvider::with_platform(Arc::clone(&desktop_platform)) at startup (mirroring constructor/mod.rs) and pass Some(Arc) into MediaProcessor::new. No new coupling — MediaProcessor already accepts Option<Arc<VisionPipeline>>.

findings.title: Rect type and its methods (new/new_unchecked/is_valid/area) are dead scaffolding with no production consumer
findings.rationale: Grep for \bRect\b across src/ finds only the definition (types.rs:75), the re-export (mod.rs:13), and the type's own unit tests (mod.rs:397-428). No non-test construction, field read, or schema consumer anywhere. The natural consumer for a pixel Rect would be OCR bounding boxes, but convert_platform_ocr_result (platform_ocr.rs:176) deliberately drops aleph_desktop::OcrResult.lines, and the vision OcrResult has no lines field — so Rect is orphaned. It is pub + re-exported, so dead_code lints cannot flag it (form 1 the compiler is blind to). Delete Rect, its impl, and the rect_validation / rect_new_unchecked tests.

findings.title: VisionError::UnsupportedFormat variant is defined but never constructed
findings.rationale: Grep for VisionError::UnsupportedFormat across the repo returns only the definition (error.rs:21). The other UnsupportedFormat hits are MediaError (media/error.rs) and SoulLoadError (thinker/soul.rs) — different enums. Every format/size failure in the vision module is reported as ImageError (e.g. platform_ocr.rs:114 reports an unsupported URL image as ImageError). The variant is part of a #[non_exhaustive] pub enum so it compiles clean and is invisible to dead_code. No live caller and no error path that would construct it → dead variant, CUT.

findings.title: ImageFormat::mime_type() and extension() have no non-test caller
findings.rationale: Grep for .mime_type() and .extension() finds no call site in src/ outside the vision module's own unit test image_format_mime_and_extension (mod.rs:435-440). Production consumers of ImageFormat (media/processor.rs:460 image_format_from_mime, media/processors/image.rs:29 to_vision_format) only map variants to/from ImageFormat; none call mime_type() or extension(). Both methods are pub const on a pub enum, so dead_code cannot catch them. Dead API → CUT.

findings.title: VisionPipeline::provider_count() and capabilities() (aggregate) have no non-test caller
findings.rationale: Grep for provider_count and .capabilities() finds provider_count used only in its own unit test (mod.rs:384-392), and VisionPipeline::capabilities() used only in aggregated_capabilities (mod.rs:361,378). No production caller: VisionBridge (builtin_tools/desktop/vision_bridge.rs) and ImageMediaProvider call understand_image/ocr directly and handle Err; the per-provider trait method capabilities() is consumed internally by the pipeline loop (mod.rs:62,103,132), but the aggregate VisionPipeline::capabilities() and provider_count() are never called outside tests. Both are pub → invisible to dead_code. Dead API → CUT. (Note: the trait method VisionProvider::capabilities is NOT dead — it is consumed internally — so only the two public aggregate accessors are in scope for the cut.)
